'''Scratch''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] who lived on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Scratch had mothered a rancor colony. A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in a battle against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. The famed [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]] of the famed [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], had commissioned the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to destroy the colony so that his temporary battalion could use their colony as shortcut to the [[Yorn Nuro|Nuro]] organization who was working with the CIS and was stealing [[Nysillin/Legends|Nysillin]] from farms. When the Jedi Knight reached the cave, they [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the rancor's offspring; Scratch saw and attacked the Jedi, however she was killed and failed in her attempt.
